about_the_game:
In a world of the selfish, few are brave enough to stand up for what really matters - the shareholders!

At the Tau Ceti Corporation, we endeavour to deliver the highest value possible, for the lowest cost. As its director of logistics, you are entrusted with keeping the gears of industry turning, the revenue numbers going up every quarter, and the fatality numbers acceptably low.

Welcome to your shift. It's going to be a busy one. Let's make some money for the Tau Ceti Corpo.

Merchants of the Stars is a "Space Traffic Control" game where you control cargo ships by clicking and dragging them, attempting to guide them to docks where they can unload. Be careful, if things get too chaotic and ships collide or run into other obstacles, such as pirates or asteroids, then you lose.

Features

  • A campaign of varied stages, each with new a new challenge to learn and master. Three stages are featured in the demo.

  • Full voice acting for story narration and ship pilots.

  • Use the station's defense laser to destroy obstacles and enemies, like asteroids and pirates.

  • Try to get a high score on each stage. Can you get 3 stars? Or perhaps even something better?

  • Unlock Zen Mode after completing each stage. This mode allows you to play forever without failing due to ship collisions. Perfect for relaxing with a little soothing space traffic control.
